These fresh faces bring the total of new characters up to six. Players also learned about a brand-new themed event they can explore while they wait for the update to release.

Following the initial D23 announcement, Disney Dreamlight Valley released a trailer in September, which revealed the first batch of new characters, including Milo Thatch from Atlantis and Megara from Hercules. Players also learned that they could transform their characters into merpeople, including being able to customize the color of their tail. Developers also teased a new environment for players to explore.

The initial release date was only revealed as launching in November, but a recent post on the Disney Dreamlight Valley has given a definitive date, along with a wave of other new details. The Keepsake Sea will be available starting on November 18, and that’s not all. While gamers wait for the expansion to arrive, they can explore the new Seafaring Star Path. The Star Path offers the opportunity to discover themed items perfect for the nautical update, including furniture, costumes, and clothes, especially for the merfolk cosmetics.

More new characters have also been revealed. From the Disney classic Peter Pan, players will be able to welcome Captain Hook and Wendy Darling to the valley. The update also introduces Adventure Companions, who can help with exploring new areas – and the first will be Dory from Finding Nemo. According to the blog post, Adventure Companions will come with their own unique rewards, and Dory will be able to accompany the player on land thanks to the safety of a special bubble.

The update also includes three new environments, including Shipwreck Shore, which is where players will first encounter Milo. Next comes Candy Cove. As the name suggests, it’s a sugary and colorful world made entirely of desserts, and features Megara and Captain Hook. The third new biome is the Kingdom of Oublié, where Wendy will be waiting, and features a world of coral seashells. Each biome will feature special underwater areas that the player can explore in their merperson cosmetic.

The Keepsake Sea also offers the player the opportunity to sail their own Enchanted Pirate Ship, which has a Captain’s Cabin that can be decorated and customized. Players can also customize the ship’s sail and flag. The ship can be utilized to pull treasure from the water, thanks to a crane onboard.

While players wait for the update, they can explore Disney Dreamlight Valley on PC, Nintendo Switch and Switch 2, Playstation, Xbox, and mobile.

items.title: Dreamlight Valley’s 'The Keepsake Sea' Adds Captain Hook, Wendy, and Dory, With More Characters Teased for 2027
items.summary: A daily-updated resource for news and information on the Disney resort around the world.
items.content:
Captain Hook and Wendy are sailing into Disney Dreamlight Valley , while Dory will help players explore underwater in the game’s next paid expansion, The Keepsake Sea .

Gameloft revealed the new characters and gameplay details during its Disney Dreamlight Valley 2026 Showcase today, ahead of the expansion’s November 18 launch.

The expansion was first previewed in September , when Gameloft announced Captain Jack Sparrow, Megara, Milo Thatch, and the ability for players to transform into customizable Merfolk.

The story of The Keepsake Sea begins at Dazzle Beach, right at home in Dreamlight Valley, where players will find a mysterious statue containing a message from a lost friend. The journey will bring players to three new island biomes.

Shipwreck Shores is a pirate-themed bay where players will meet Milo and Jack Sparrow. Candy Cove is a frosty fantasy landscape made of desserts, where Megara and—as revealed today—Captain Hook will appear. In the Kingdom of Oublié, players will find a fanciful setting of coral and seashell designs that stretch above and below the water.

Also revealed in today’s showcase, Wendy Darling from Peter Pan will be joining the cast of characters coming to the new expansion.

Each biome has an underwater area to explore. Dory from Finding Nemo will also join the Valley as a new Adventure Companion who helps players navigate underwater and find items beneath the sea. On land, she travels inside a bubble, similar to other aquatic characters revealed below.

Players can customize their Merfolk form with different ears, fins, arms, torsos, and tail patterns, along with color options. Merfolk can interact with villagers and the environment, opening up new possibilities for Photo Mode and DreamSnaps. Players can also swim across the surface in the Valley and previous expansions, then dive into ripples to collect fish.

Underwater areas can be decorated with themed architectural kits, water props, and furniture. Special platforms let players raise and lower decorations at different elevations, and Decoration Blueprints will return with centerpiece furniture to restore.

The expansion also adds an Enchanted Pirate Ship to use in exploring new and uncharted waterways. Players can customize its sail and flag, use its crane to salvage items from the water, and bring up to two villagers along as crewmates. Below deck, a customizable Captain’s Cabin includes crafting, cooking, and storage. The ship also has a dedicated Photo Mode for players to pose with their custom crew.

A new Seafaring Star Path begins today and runs through December 2, alongside the ongoing Haunting Elegance Star Path . New rewards include nautical furniture, Merfolk attire, captain’s clothing, and much more. The free “Ohana Holidays” update arrives December 9, bringing Lilo to the Valley and adding a new holiday-themed Star Path.

The Keepsake Sea Deluxe Edition, priced at $49.99, includes Flounder and Sebastian as additional Adventure Companions. Each will have a special quest featuring Ariel, unlock rewards as they level up, and be able to follow players on land and underwater.

The standard expansion purchase includes 5,000 Moonstones; the Deluxe Edition includes 10,000 Moonstones, Gilded Shell Tops, and a Merfolk Mansion house style.

Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition owners will have access to the expansion on launch day without an additional purchase.

items.title: Everything Coming to the Keepsake Sea Expansion
items.summary: Disney Dreamlight Valley's latest expansion, the Keepsake Sea, sees players rediscover a lost region that once existed off the coast of the Valley. Travel
items.content:
Disney Dreamlight Valley's latest expansion, the Keepsake Sea, sees players rediscover a lost region that once existed off the coast of the Valley. Travel both above the water on your very own Pirate Ship and below the waves as a merfolk, visit three new Biomes, meet new Villagers and Companions, and awaken the long-sleeping Guardians to restore the Keepsake Sea to its former glory! Arriving on November 18, 2026, the Keepsake Sea might just be Dreamlight Valley's most exciting expansion yet.

More information about the expansion was revealed during a special Disney Dreamlight Valley showcase on October 21, 2026. Here's an overview of what's coming in this brand-new expansion:

The Keepsake Sea is filled with exciting friends to meet! First, in the Shipwreck Shores biome, you'll get to know Milo Thatch from the film Atlantis as well as the iconic pirate captain, Captain Jack Sparrow from the Pirates of the Caribbean franchise.

Then, head to Candy Cove to meet Megara, the witty and clever heroine of Disneys' Hercules - and, yes, you'll get to reunite her with Herc! Then, befriend an iconic Disney villain: Captain Hook, the scheming nemesis of Peter Pan, who is less than happy to be trapped in a land made of candy.

Finally, journey to a lost seaside kingdom to find Wendy, Peter Pan's dear friend, who will share with you some surprising secrets about the origin of the Forgetting! All five of these Villagers will bring with them exciting new Quests to complete and Rewards to earn.

The Villagers aren't the only friends you'll be making in the Keepsake Sea! Living under the water is none other than Dory, the forgetful fish from Finding Nemo. Dory will join you as a Companion, able to help you collect underwater materials. Level up your Friendship with her to unlock exclusive rewards. And don't worry - Dory can accompany you above the water too with the help of a special bubble she can travel in!

Your journey in the Keepsake Sea will begin when you find a strange statue in the waters off Dazzle Beach. Interact with the statue to reach the Keepsake Sea region, which consists of three new Biomes: Shipwreck Shores, Candy Cove, and the Kingdom of Oublie.

There, you'll need to prove your childlike spirit to awaken four Guardians who once protected the land. Along the way, you'll decipher a mysterious map with Milo, explore a possibly haunted fortress with Jack Sparrow, discover lost relics with Captain Hook, and learn secrets about the Valley's past from Wendy!

The Keepseak Sea expansion introduces the ability to dive underneath the water and turn into a merfolk form. This new form will be granted by none other than Ursula! Your merfolk form is extremely customizable - you can change your ears, fins, arms, torso, and even your tail pattern. There are tons of colors, patterns, and outfits to choose from, including tails inspired by various types of fish and even sea monsters!

As a merfolk, you can explore underwater in all areas of the Keepsake Sea. The underwater world features materials you can gather by swimming through them, including both new materials and returning ingredients such as Seaweed. You can even find scrolls and other strange treasures in bubbles beneath the sea!

Swimming underwater isn't the only thing you can do in your finned form. You can swim on top of any large body of water - including those in Dreamlight Valley and its expansions, such as Dazzle Beach or Storybook Vale's The Bind! While in this form, you can swim through ripples to quickly pick up Fish, Seafood, and other materials. No need to get your Fishing Rod out at all!

You'll also be able to interact with Villagers under the water - they'll explore the area in personal submarines similar to the one Milo Thatch uses. Plus, Photo Mode is still fully accessible in merfolk form. You can even submit DreamSnaps featuring your tailed look!

You'll be able to enter Furniture Mode in underwater areas to add decoration, furniture, natural features, and even buildings. New platforms and plateaus let you create a multi-leveled scene, adding verticality and depth to your underwater world. Blueprints, first introduced in the Wishblossom Ranch expansion, also return - add the needed Crafting Materials to restore various decorative pieces around the Keepsake Sea!

You'll also unlock thematic Crafting Recipes and decorative items relating to each of the expansion's new Biomes. Shipwreck Shores is all about reclaimed driftwood and salvaging what you can, while Candy Cove recreates a frosty northern village using ice cream, icing, and other types of dessert. The Kingdom of Oublie is a mysterious location with buildings made from shells and coral, truly fitting the vibe of a lost kingdom partially reclaimed by the sea. The Showcase stated that this expansion will have more decorations and craftable items than ever before!

items.title: Catch up on the Disney Dreamlight Valley 2026 Showcase Stream!
items.summary: Ahoy Valley Villagers! Today, we were thrilled to preview our upcoming free update and give you a sneak peek at some of the exciting new content coming in 2027! But, first thing's first, we have news about our upcoming expansion that's just
items.content:
Ahoy Valley Villagers!

Today, we were thrilled to preview our upcoming free update and give you a sneak peek at some of the exciting new content coming in 2027! But, first thing's first, we have news about our upcoming expansion that's just on the horizon – Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea, arriving November 18th, 2026.

If you missed the Showcase stream, you can catch up with it right here:

Seafaring Star Paths!

Firstly, we're happy to announce that while you wait for our next expansion release, we're launching an additional brand-new Star Path...  right now!  From October 21 to December 2nd, you'll be able to prepare for The Keepsake Sea by unlocking thematic rewards in the all-new Seafaring Star Path that you’ll be able to use on this expansion!

Set sail on this Star Path to uncover the treasures that lie within, such as new nautical furniture pieces, mystical Merfolk attire and royal captains' garb for sailing the high seas. Continue progressing through the path and you'll even be able to recruit your very own first mate!

Bringing familial warmth to the Valley

Speaking of, in our next free update, 'Ohana Holidays, Lilo from Disney's Lilo & Stitch is coming to Disney Dreamlight Valley on December 9th! Lilo and Stitch's grand reunion is sure to bring a healthy dose of warmth and joy to your Valley, just in time for the holidays! 'Ohana Holidays will also be bringing a new Star Path with a quirky take on holiday celebrations and much more. Stay tuned for updates!

A sea full of adventure!

On November 18th, our next expansion Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea sets sail! In this expansion, you'll transform into a magical Merfolk and discover strange echoes of the past, hinting at the Keepsake Sea's history which goes back to the very heart of Dreamlight Valley, and the start of the Forgetting.

Your journey to the Keepsake Sea begins at Dazzle Beach, where you'll discover a mysterious statue that contains a message from an old friend that is lost and stranded. To find them, you'll need to reach a faraway kingdom across the sea...

On your adventure you'll encounter 4 Guardians that watch over The Keepsake Sea. You'll first need to awaken each from their slumber before you can prove you have a childlike spirit.

This adventure will take you to three brand new island Biomes with unique environments, where you'll meet a slew of new venturing Disney and Pixar characters!

The first island you'll encounter is Shipwreck Shores, a colorful take on a typical pirate bay, where you’ll meet Milo Thatch from Disney’s Atlantis: The Lost Empire and Captain Jack Sparrow from Disney’s Pirates of the Caribbean!

After Shipwreck Shores, you'll discover Candy Cove, the second Biome, a quaint fantasy world made up of frosty desserts. Here you'll meet Megara from Disney’s Hercules and Captain Hook from Disney’s Peter Pan!

Oh, and we can’t forget there's also a magical narwal!

Lastly, you'll explore the Kingdom of Oublié, a special place that extends above and below the sea, made up of coral seashell motifs. In this forgotten kingdom you'll meet Wendy from Disney’s Peter Pan.

Each of these magnificent Biomes will also have their own underwater areas! In your Merfolk form, you'll be able to explore these new environments and customize them to make them your own!

It's in these new environments that you'll be introduced to a brand-new type of companion... Adventure Companions! In these waters you'll meet Dory from Disney and Pixar’s Finding Nemo! Dory will help you navigate the underwater areas and what they have to offer... if she can remember where anything is or who you are! Like Notable Companions, Adventure Companions will come with their own rewards and will help you find items deep beneath the sea while accompanying you in a special bubble while on land.

Underwater decorations and customization

We can't wait to share these magical new places and see the creative ways you'll create your own world above and under the waves. Each main Biome will feature thematic architectural kits, underwater decorations, and water props.

Decorate these new underwater areas at different elevations using special platforms to raise or lower items, adding new depth and dimension to your builds.

Decoration Blueprints are also returning in this expansion, with new grand centerpiece furniture to be restored as you go about your journey.

Your underwater adventures will begin when you unlock your Merfolk form, with new customization options including ears, fins, arms, torsos, tail patterns, and plenty of color options.

While in Merfolk form, you can still interact with Villagers and the environment, opening up new Photo Mode and DreamSnaps possibilities.

You’ll also be able to swim across the surface water throughout the Valley and previous expansions, diving into ripples to collect fish instantly!

Set sails matey!

Every great sea adventure needs a ship, and The Keepsake Sea has its very own Enchanted Pirate Ship.

As you progress, use your ship’s crane to salvage items from the water, customize its sail and flag and bring up to two Villagers along as crewmates!

The Pirate Ship also comes with its own dedicated Photo Mode experience. When you’re ready to take a break from adventuring, head below deck to your very own Captain's Cabin, which can be fully decorated and customized, with access to crafting, cooking, and storage.

New Editions and Early Adopter Bonus

Looking to dive right into the new content that awaits you in the expansion on day one?

For owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley, the base game, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea will be available as an additional purchase with a bundle of 5,000 Moonstones, or as part of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea – Deluxe Edition, which includes 10,000 Moonstones an exclusive Gilded Shell Tops clothing items, a Merfolk Mansion House Style, AND two new Adventure Companions, Flounder and Sebastian from Disney’s The Little Mermaid! Each one arrives with a special quest that includes Ariel, and both unlock reward items by levelling them up, just like companions, and they'll be able to follow you both on land and underwater!

Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition owners will have access to the contents of The Keepsake Sea expansion on day one without the need for additional purchase.

If you’re new to Disney Dreamlight Valley, these are great starting points!

  • The Disney Dreamlight Valley – The Keepsake Sea Edition, which grants access to the base game, the new expansion, and a bundle of Moonstones.

    [/*]

  • The new Disney Dreamlight Valley – Ultimate Edition 2026, which includes access to the base game, the Wishblossom Ranch expansion, all the contents of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea – Deluxe Edition mentioned above, and a bundle of Moonstones.

    [/*]

Finally, with any purchase of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea expansion, if you play the game between launch day November 18th and December 2nd, you will also earn an exclusive fin for your mermaids! 

What's next?

While there is a ton to get excited for the remainder of 2026, we’re getting ready to hit the ground running next year! Check out our early 2027 roadmap below: 

Twitch Drops

Last but not least, this Showcase also kicked off a NEW Twitch Drops activation!

From today, October 21st until October 28th, you can watch our partnered creators Disney Dreamlight Valley streams to unlock an exclusive skin for your Pirate Crocodile Companion!

For participation and partnered creators’ details, visit our website: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/twitch-drops

And keep an eye out for another Twitch Drops activation when Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea launches, featuring an exclusive Sea Witch Ship skin!

________________

We can’t wait for you to experience everything in this new expansion when Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea launches on November 18th, and for you to welcome Lilo to your Valleys in our free content update, 'Ohana Holidays, on December 9th. Thank you for taking part in this magical journey with us!

See you in the Valley, and on the open seas very soon!

items.content:
After you derailed Oogie Boogie's plans in The Ghost in the Portrait and Rescue Mission , Halloween Town's resident trickster has cooked up his biggest scheme yet. In Let the Games Begin, the fifth Quest in the chain required to unlock Oogie Boogie as a Villager , you will have to return to the Boogieman's lair and survive a gauntlet of devilishly tricky games!

Let the Games Begin initially released on October 21, 2026. You must have completed Oogie Boogie's previous Quests , up through Rescue Mission , to begin it. Like the previous Quests in the series, it will begin when you receive a letter from Oogie Boogie in your Mailbox.

If you want to unlock Oogie Boogie in 2026, you MUST begin his first Quest, A Halloween Invasion , no later than November 4, 2026. Once you have begun the first Quest, the other five can be completed at any time once they have unlocked.

As long as you have STARTED A Halloween Invasion, you will be able to unlock Oogie Boogie, even if you finish up the Quest chain after November 4.

If you missed out on Oogie Boogie in 2026, he will return to the Valley in October 2027 !

Oogie Boogie's letter will blame you for breaking his Lucky Wheel in the previous Quests and demand that you make him a new one. He will send you a Lucky Wheel Cog, which you must use alongside the five Lucky Wheel Cogs you previously picked up when breaking the Wheel during the Quest The Ghost in the Portrait .

At any Crafting Station in the Valley, use the six Lucky Wheel Cogs to craft a Genuinely Lucky Wheel.

Enter Oogie Boogie's Lair via the Strange Mirror in Scrooge's Store. Head up to the top left corner, where Oogie Boogie will be standing next to the broken Wheel, and give him the Genuinely Lucky Wheel.

Oogie Boogie then reveals the surprise he has for you this week: you must play his various mini-games and collect an Oogie Boogie Tile from each one. You need to collect a total of four Oogie Boogie Tiles to complete this Quest. Note that you can also ask Oogie Boogie for more information about any of his mini-games.

Head up to the Genuinely Lucky Wheel and spin it by approaching the lever on the left and selecting the Interact prompt when it appears.

You need to spin the Genuinely Lucky Wheel a total of five times to receive your Oogie Boogie Tile. You are guaranteed to get the Tile on your fifth spin. Spins one through four will reward you with a variety of items, such as:

On your fifth spin, a Red Chest containing the Tile will appear. Open the Chest and claim your reward!

Whack-a-Pumpkin, the mini-game that first appeared during the Quest A Halloween Invasion , is back again! To begin a game of Whack-a-Pumpkin, head to the fenced-off area in the center of the upper floor of Oogie Boogie's Lair. There is a stack of dice with a pumpkin-shaped button on it. Approach the button and press "Interact" to start a game.

While the game is active, pumpkins will pop up in a 3 x 3 grid inside the fence. Use your Royal Pickaxe to whack the pumpkins as they appear.

To unlock the Let the Games Begin quest, you first need to ensure all necessary prerequisites have been finished. This is the fifth mission in Oogie Boogie's quest unlock series , which means the four quests that come before it must be finished before you can get going on it. You also need to have Zero unlocked. All of the tasks you must have done are as follows.

Once all of these key tasks are finished, head to any mailbox you have placed around your valley homes to get started with the Let the Games Begin quest.

Open the letter in your mailbox to start the Let the Games Begin quest and claim a Lucky Wheel Cog . Then, grab the six Lucky Wheel Cogs you previously picked up during the Rescue Mission quest. Head to any crafting station to combine these items into a Genuinely Lucky Wheel. Head into the Mirror Lair and chat with Oogie Boogie to show off your creation.

At this point in the quest, it breaks off into four smaller mini missions you need to get done. For each one, you must successfully play and navigate through Oogie Boogie's minigames around the Mirror Lair.

Oogie Boogie's wheel is finally not rigged against you, so approach and interact with the Genuinely Lucky Wheel for the first minigame. Spin it a total of five times to obtain an Oogie Boogie Tile from a chest that spawns nearby.

Next up, you must embark on a scavenger hunt around the Mirror Lair to locate five Hidden Smiles . The precise locations of each one are as follows.

On the stack of dice close to the Lucky Wheel. Head up the stairs on the left side of the room and check out the dice near the enclosure on your left to spot this one.

On a skeleton near the Lucky Wheel. Head inside the enclosure right behind the stack of dice where you found the last Hidden Smile. Look at the skeleton inside this area to spot the next one.

On the Whack-A-Pumpkin wall. On the second floor, enter the Whack-A-Pumpkin game enclosure. Look at the wall to find another Hidden Smile.

items.content:
Get ready for a frightfully fun update with Season of Scares, now available on all platforms!

This Halloween, Oogie Boogie from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas is bringing his tricks to the Valley. Investigate a mysterious mirror in Scrooge’s Store, step through to a strange new version of the shop, take on his games, and uncover what this Halloween trickster has planned. 

And that's not all! Season of Scares introduces new decorating tools, exciting new events, the Event Board, Decoration Preset code sharing, Floating Island improvements, and more.

A Halloween Adventure with Oogie Boogie

Oogie Boogie has arrived in the Valley, and he's ready to cause some trouble!

Follow the strange happenings surrounding a mysterious mirror in Scrooge McDuck's Store and venture through it, where new games, challenges and rewards await each week.

Want to know when to check in and what to expect? Check out our dedicated Oogie Boogie's Halloween Event blog for the full event schedule and everything you need to know. 

Haunting Elegance Star Path

It's time to give your Valley a bewitching Halloween makeover with the Haunting Elegance Star Path!

Unlock charming outfits, darkly whimsical furniture, Halloween-inspired decorations, and more as you complete Star Path Duties.

Give your home a festive new look with the Tricks and Treats House and get Scrooge McDuck ready for the season with a new Dream Style.

A Season of Scares Premium Shop

The Premium Shop is getting into the Halloween spirit with plenty of new ways to dress up your Valley.

Look out for the Evil & Good Witch Bundle, featuring magical outfits, enchanting furniture, and matching bee-witching Companions.

You'll also be able to become Little Red Riding Hood, inspired by Disney's television series Once Upon a Time, complete with a Big Bad Wolf-inspired canine Companion.

Other additions include Stitch's Vampire Costume Dream Style, a new Sinister Bridge Kit with a matching garden set, and a Companion Bundle featuring Lucifer from Disney's Cinderella.

Share Your Valley Creations

Decoration Presets are getting a major upgrade in Season of Scares, with a brand-new way to share your favorite designs with other Valley Villagers!

You can now create and share your own Presets using code sharing. Simply hover over any of your Presets to generate a unique code that you can give to other Valley Villagers. Codes are valid for 14 days, even if the creator has changed or removed the original Preset.

Looking for a little inspiration? We're also giving you three ready-to-use Decoration Presets inspired by the season, so you can create your very own witchy backyard with just a few clicks! 

Keep an eye on our socials to get the codes, then show us how you make them your own! Once added to your collection, these Presets are yours to use whenever you'd like to celebrate the season. 

New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

With new ways to share your designs, Season of Scares also gives you more freedom to build and refresh your Valley.

More Freedom with Floating Islands

Looking for even more room to bring your ideas to life?

You can now move select characters stalls and some functional buildings around the Valley on Floating Islands, opening up even more possibilities for your Valley layouts. Expansion versions of eligible stalls and buildings can also be moved to their corresponding expansion’s Floating Island. Check out the latest Patch Notes for the full list of buildings and stalls that can be placed on Floating Islands.

Clear Biomes Instantly

Ever wanted to redecorate a Biome without having to remove everything piece by piece?

The new Clear Biome feature lets you quickly remove Furniture, Landscaping, Fences, and Paths from a Biome or Sub-Biome. Choose exactly what you want to clear, and if you change your mind, you can undo your changes before saving.

We're also expanding Biome-specific crafting with a new collection of witchy furniture inspired by the Forest of Valor.

Introducing the Event Board

With so much happening around the Valley, it can be tricky to keep track of it all. That's where the new Event Board comes in!

The Astronomer's Journey Star Path is a permanent introductory Star Path available to all players. After unlocking your first Realm and speaking with Merlin, you’ll begin the Astronomer’s Journey Star Path and be introduced to the new Event Board, which you’ll be asked to place in the Plaza. Complete quests around the Valley at your own pace to unlock special astronomy-inspired rewards. For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.

Use the Event Board to keep track of up to three live events without having to search through your Menu, leave messages, and see messages from Valley Visitors. 

Olaf's Grand Exhibition Finale

Olaf's Grand Exhibition reaches its grand finale with two new rooms inspired by the Forgotten Lands and Valley Plaza.

Complete the Exhibition to unlock two new stunning furniture pieces and a Scholarly Fox Companion as a reward for your hard work.

More Ways to Express Yourself

Season of Scares also brings several improvements to Photo Mode and emotes.

Photo Mode Gallery

Your Gallery can now hold up to 12 pictures, while the DreamSnaps Archive lets you browse six months of DreamSnaps. You can also pin up to three favorite entries and share previous entries, with QR codes making it easier to share your favorite creations.

QR codes expire after 7 days, while the DreamSnaps Archive automatically removes the oldest unpinned entries after six months. Gallery contents will be automatically cleared after 180 days of inactivity.

Emote Wheel

Strike a pose anywhere in your Valley with the new Emote Wheel! Use emotes and poses outside of Photo Mode while exploring, decorating, or spending time with your favorite Villagers. Perform emotes around your Villagers  to see how they react, or show off your moves to friends while playing in multiplayer!

More Halloween Fun

The Halloween festivities don't stop with Oogie Boogie!

Haunted Floating Festival : October 7–31

Explore the decorated festival grounds, solve new and returning puzzles, and earn exclusive seasonal decorations.

Trick or Treat : October 14–31

Collect delicious Trick or Treater’s Bounty around the Plaza or go door to door at homes featuring a jack-o'-lantern at the door to collect candy. This year's rewards include new exterior decorations inspired by Halloween Town from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas.

We can't wait for you to experience everything Season of Scares has to offer! From Oogie Boogie's challenges and new ways to share your creations, to exciting decorating upgrades and Halloween festivities throughout the Valley, there's plenty to discover.

X: https://gmlft.co/DDV-X

Facebook: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook

YouTube: https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube

TikTok: https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok

As always, should you run into any issues while playing Disney Dreamlight Valley, we first recommend that you check out our known issues here. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via our contact form. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly Discord Community for some Disney Dreamlight Valley tips and tricks!

Oogie Boogie from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas is bringing his tricks to the Valley, and we've got you covered with everything you need to know to make the most of his six-week series of challenges. 

Starting September 23, you'll step through the mysterious mirror in Scrooge’s Store, take on a series of weekly challenges, and uncover what this Halloween trickster has planned for the Valley. Just be sure to begin Oogie Boogie’s first quest before November 4th to unlock the full questline and complete it at your own pace. Otherwise, you’ll have to wait until next year to get Oogie Boogie.

Along the way, you'll have the chance to unlock exclusive rewards, including Jack Skellington’s ghostly pup Zero and, ultimately, Oogie Boogie himself!

Event Overview

Season of Scares features a six-week series of quests with Oogie Boogie and his games.

Each week, a new challenge will become available, giving you new activities to complete and rewards to uncover.

To begin Oogie Boogie’s quests, make sure you've unlocked:

  • The Peaceful Meadow

    [/*]

  • Scrooge McDuck's Store

    [/*]

  • Chez Remy 

    [/*]

Once these requirements are met, keep an eye on your Mail and head to Scrooge McDuck's Store to discover where Oogie Boogie’s quest begins.

Event Schedule

Step into Oogie Boogie's version of Scrooge's Store and discover new games and rewards each week throughout the Season of Scares. Check back regularly to see what's waiting for you!

Here's the full schedule:

  • September 23: Week 1 — A Halloween Invasion

    [/*]

  • September 30: Week 2 — The Oogie Boogie Contract

    [/*]

  • October 7: Week 3 — The Ghost in the Portrait

    [/*]

  • October 14: Week 4 — Rescue Mission

    [/*]

  • October 21: Week 5 — Let the Games Begin

    [/*]

  • October 28: Week 6 — Oogie Boogie's Big Game 

    [/*]

After November 4, Oogie Boogie will leave the Valley, but if you've begun his quests before the event ends, you'll still be able to complete his quests and unlock Oogie Boogie as a villager and Zero as a companion.

If you don't unlock Oogie Boogie during Season of Scares, don't worry, he'll return around Halloween next year!

Rewards & Unlockables 

Complete Oogie Boogie's challenges to earn a variety of Halloween-themed rewards throughout the event. 

And there's something extra special waiting for you along the way...

Zero 

Continue your adventure to unlock Zero, Jack Skellington’s ghostly pup the from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas, as a permanent Companion for your Valley. 

Oogie Boogie 

Complete the full Season of Scares quests to permanently welcome Oogie Boogie to your Valley! 

So, mark your calendars, check in each week, and get ready for some Halloween fun. 

We can't wait to see what you get up to with Oogie Boogie! 🎃

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re just cackling at having shared a first look at the Season of Scares free update in our latest \[Developer Update] video! Now, let’s dive into what you can expect from this update.

In Season of Scares, you'll meet the trickster Oogie Boogie, from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas, in a six-week Halloween bash for the ages! This time you'll need to complete a series of thrilling challenges to unlock Jack Skellington's rival and a ghostly canine.

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Season of Scares free update arrives on September 23, 2026. Check out all the details below!

NEW CONTENT OVERVIEW

To kick off the events of Season of Scares, you’ll need to unlock The Peaceful Meadow, Scrooge McDucks's Store and Chez Remy's restaurant.

  • Investigate a strange mirror that has appeared in Scrooge McDuck's shop and enter it to discover Oogie Boogie's lair!

    [/*]

  • Now here's the trick – this time instead of unlocking Oogie Boogie first and then tackling his quests, you'll earn your rewards and unlock him by playing through his tricky challenges, from September 23rd to November 4th.

    [/*]

  • Complete all six weeks of Oogie Boogie's challenges, from choosing to (or not to) go along with his schemes, all the way to a final showdown — to permanently welcome him into your Valley!

    [/*]

  • At some point in your weekly trials, you may encounter a ghostly loyal companion ... That’s right – in one of Oogie Boogie’s quests you’ll be able to unlock Zero, from Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas.

    • Beware, after November 4th, Oogie Boogie will be leaving the Valley until Halloween next year... but worry not! As long as you begin the first of these quests before November 4, you’ll be able to unlock Oogie Boogie and Zero at your own pace.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Along with the Season of Scares arrives the frightfully delightful Haunting Elegance Star Path! Charm all your trick-or-treating guests with new bewitching attires and adorn your Valley with new dark whimsical furniture pieces. Give your house a festive new look with the Tricks and Treats House and get Scrooge McDuck in the mood for a good scare with the perfect Skeleton Scrooge Dream Style.

    [/*]

  • October 7th marks the return of the Haunted Floating Festival event! Until October 31st, explore the decorated festival grounds to discover new and returning puzzles, and earn exclusive seasonal decorations for solving them!

    [/*]

  • Then, Starting October 14th until October 31st, the Trick or Treat event is back, featuring an all-new way to earn candy! Collect frightfully delicious Trick-or-Treater's Bounty from around the Plaza, or now, by going door to door, trick-or-treating at houses that feature a jack-o'-lantern outside! New rewards for this year include Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas Halloween Town exterior decorations! 

    [/*]

  • Arriving to the Premium Shop this update is the Evil & Good Witch Bundle, featuring new wickedly magical attires, enchanting new furniture pieces and matching bee-witching companions.

    [/*]

  • This Halloween you’ll also be able to dress up as Red Riding Hood with a new costume inspired by Disney’s television series Once Upon a Time, complete with its very own new Red Riding Hood Wolf companion!   

    [/*]

  • Stitch will also be embracing the festivities with his new Vampire Costume Stitch Dream Style.

    [/*]

  • Season of Scares will also come with a new Sinister Bridge Kit, complete with its own garden set, and a new Companion Bundle welcoming Lucifer, from Disney's Cinderella, who arrives with the special ability to chase after critters, gathering rewards and unique Photo Mode poses. 

    [/*]

  • In Season of Scares, we’re introducing the Event Board! This new feature is part of the new introductory Star Path: the Astronomer’s Journey Star Path. See below for more details.

    [/*]

  • Decoration Presets codes are here! Create and share your Presets with other Valley Villagers using code sharing!

    [/*]

  • As of this update, you’ll also be able to place some gameplay buildings on floating islands. See below for details.

    [/*]

  • Finaly, the last rooms in Olaf's Grand Exhibition will be opening, along with all new rewards for those who complete all the exhibition rooms!

    [/*]

  • You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as the Aqua Mermaid Backpack, the Scarlet Gothic Chair, the Cozy Autumn Bed, Botanical Vine Flower Lamp, and more.

    [/*]

Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include access to the Premium Shop. In addition, the Haunted Elegance Star Path on Apple Arcade will be delayed until later this October, and both the Event Board and Astronomer’s Journey Star Path will only be available in our next free update.

 

FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS

OLAF’S GRAND EXHIBITION

Final Rooms and Completion Rewards

  • Finally, Olaf's Grand Exhibition will be opening its two final rooms based on the Forgotten Lands and Valley Plaza.

    • The Plaza exhibition room will come with 2 Dioramas and a companion Habitat.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Each time a room is completed, a Biome icon will appear on the lobby carpet. Once all 8 rooms are completed, 3 chests containing the Grand Exhibition’s completion rewards will appear. These rewards will consist of two stunning new furniture pieces – the Grand Exhibition Window and the Grand Exhibition Fountain – and a delightful new Scholarly Fox companion for all your hard work.

    [/*]

DECORATING

Presets Code Sharing

Decoration Presets codes are here!

  • Create and share your Presets with other Valley Villagers using code sharing! By selecting Share Presets in the Presets option menu, you'll now be able to generate a unique code that can be given to others to use.

    [/*]

  • Codes are valid for 14 days, even if the creator of the Preset has changed or removed their creation.

    [/*]

  • We've also updated the Mirage function.

    • If an item can be found in the Premium Shop, you will be redirected to it.

      [/*]

    • If the item is from a current Star Path, it will redirect you to the correct page.

      [/*]

    • If the item was from a limited series or bundle, and/or is not currently available, you will see a pop-up saying, “This item is not available for now.”

      [/*]
    [/*]

Mirages in Edit Mode

Remove creative blockers with Mirage, or two.

  • If you’re low on decorations when using the Duplicate option in Edit Mode, you will no longer need to stop and go searching for items. Instead, you’ll place a Mirage placeholder and be able to continue creating!

    [/*]

Floating Islands

  • As of this update, we're helping further unlock your decorative creativity by allowing for some functional buildings around the Valley and stalls, including most character stalls, to now be placed on floating islands.

    [/*]

  • The following can be moved to any Floating Island:

    • Tiana’s Palace

      [/*]

    • The Boutique

      [/*]

    • Olaf’s Grand Exhibition

      [/*]

    • Stables

      [/*]

    • Valley Visit Station (however, you won’t be able to interact with it when it’s on a Floating Island).

      [/*]

    • WALL•E's Garden

      [/*]

    • Moana's Boat

      [/*]

    • Beast's Greenhouse

      [/*]

    • Aladdin's Gem Stall

      [/*]

    • Kristoff’s Stall

      [/*]

    • Mulan’s Tea Stall

      [/*]

    • Tiana's Meal Stall

      [/*]
    [/*]

Expansion versions of these buildings and stalls can also be moved to that expansion’s floating islands.

New Biome Crafting Recipes

We're expanding the new Biome-specific crafting recipes!

  • In Season of Scares, you’ll be able to complete a mysterious array of new witchy-inspired arcane furniture pieces for your Forest of Valor.

    [/*]

Clear Biome

Finally arriving in this update is an all-new way to remove items from any of your Biomes!

  • You ‘ll be able to toggle and choose if you want to clear Furniture (furniture and decorations), Landscaping (decorative trees, bushes, and rocks), Fences, and/or Paths from any decorated Biome (or Sub-Biome for expansions).

    [/*]

STAR PATH

Apple Arcade Star Path

That's right, if you play on Apple Arcade, you'll now also get new Star Path events every update! The first Apple Arcade Star Path, Haunting Elegance, will launch later this October. These will function similarly to the regular Star Paths on consoles, with the following differences: 

  • There will be no Premium Track or Premium Rewards.

    [/*]

  • There will be no Moonstones or purchasable Tokens.

    [/*]

  • Weekly Routine Duties will be replaced by Daily Duties.

    [/*]

  • Instead of Routine Duties engagement unlocking Vault rewards, you will have Daily Duties unlocking “Milestone Rewards”.

    • These rewards will be made up of consumable items like Star Coins, Dreamlight, Potions, etc.

      [/*]
    [/*]

New Introductory Star Path

Participate in a new permanent Star Path: The Astronomer's Journey Star Path.

  • After having unlocked your first realm and speaking to Merlin, you'll be able to start completing this new introductory Star Path.

    [/*]

  • Progress at your own pace by completing quests around the Valley to unlock special astronomy-based rewards.

    • As with all other introductory quests, this Star Path can only be completed once.

      [/*]
    [/*]

For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.

EVENTS

Event Board

In this update, we’re introducing the Event Board.

  • While completing The Astronomer’s Journey Star Path, you will be introduced to the new Event Board, which you’ll be asked to place in the Plaza.

    [/*]

  • The Event Board is a physical item in your Valley that allows you to keep track of up to three live events without having to search your Menu!

    [/*]

For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.

PHOTO MODE

We've made improvements to Photo Mode that will make it easier than ever to share your favorite pics!

My Saved Photos

  • You’ll now be able to save up to 12 photos from Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • These saved pictures can be viewed, submitted to DreamSnaps (if eligible), shared with friends (by creating a QR code), or shared to your DreamTeams feed.

    [/*]

  • Saved pictures can be deleted at any time.

    [/*]

DreamSnaps Archive

Your recent DreamSnaps submissions will be auto saved in the DreamSnaps Archive once the Challenge is done, and results are sent, for up to 6 months.

  • You’ll also be able to pin up to 3 favorites to keep them!

    • Pinned DreamSnaps are never auto-removed.

      [/*]

    • Unpinned DreamSnaps are removed once their expiration timer runs out.

      [/*]
    [/*]

QR Codes

  • You’ll now be able to generate QR codes for your saved pictures that will last 7 days.

    [/*]

  • You’ll be able to have 12 codes at a time.

    [/*]

Also important to note that your Photo Gallery and DreamSnaps Archive will live on your online profile, so you'll want to stay signed in and active to keep them saved!

  • If you don't play for 180 days, Saved Photos and DreamSnaps Archive entries are deleted automatically.

    [/*]

Finally, sharing a photo on the DreamTeams feed or generating a QR code doesn't remove it from your Photo Gallery.

Emotes Wheel

  • You'll now be able to strike a pose and emote outside of Photo Mode with the new Emote Wheel!

    [/*]

  • At launch, there will be 11 free emotes available for use.

    [/*]

  • You’ll be able to perform these emotes in multiplayer and watch your friends react to them, or around your own Villagers and see their reactions!

    [/*]

DREAMSNAPS

Super Votes

Introducing a new “Super Vote” option!

  • To help reward the most mesmerizing submissions, you’ll be able to vote for BOTH presented DreamSnaps at the same time using a Super Vote!

    [/*]

  • You’ll have 2 Super Votes per day.

    [/*]

Updated Visual Interface

  • We’ve updated the UI in the 1v1 voting screens to standardize the way DreamSnaps are presented. This means both images will occupy the same amount of space.

    [/*]

  • You'll still have the option to view any image in “full screen” before voting.

    [/*]

MISC

Map Improvements

  • We've started rolling out improvement on the Map that will help reduce clutter, contains more information, and overall makes it easier to interact with your Villagers:

    • Map Uncluttering which redistributes the character icons when they are in the same building.

      [/*]

    • Cursor proximity mode makes icons fan out when the cursor is placed over them for simpler selection.

      [/*]

    • On-hover cursor info is updated.

      [/*]

    • A new Avatar orientation indicator tells you which way you’re facing.

      [/*]

    • Missing labels, icons, and caves have been added.

      [/*]

    • And Fast Travel improvements, like opening on the Favorites by default.

      [/*]
    [/*]

More Map improvements will be rolled out in future updates, so stay tuned!

New Shop Bundle Type

  • For the first time, you'll be able to update Villager Houses with their own House Skins, starting with the Snowy Beast’s Castle!

    [/*]

General Economy Update

In the Season of Scares, we've rolled out updates on the value of various in-game content, like the cost of unlocking Realms, or Villager houses, to provide an overall more cohesive gameplay experience. See details here: LINK

TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES

  • Fixed an issue where you were unable to gift multiple of the same quest item at once.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue with the quest “Scrooge McDuck’s Grand Re-opening" where it would get stuck at the Craft Dandelion and Rising Penstemon Pot objective.

items.content:
Hey, Valley Villagers!

Get ready to power up your Valley with our latest update: Pixel Perfect, now available on all platforms!

In this update, you'll get to team up with the Forgotten once again to investigate a series of mysterious glitchy arcade machines appearing throughout the Valley. Follow the clues, uncover the source of the chaos, and help bring Ralph from Disney's Wreck-It Ralph to the Valley.

A Glitchy Mystery

To begin your journey, both the Forgotten and Peter Pan will need to be unlocked, and you need to have completed the quest "The Music's on the Walls."

As you investigate strange glitches appearing throughout the Valley, a mysterious arcade machine begins showing up in unexpected places. Complete the machine's strange requests to uncover its mysterious origins. 

What starts as a strange glitch quickly grows into a much bigger mystery. By following the clues, you'll discover the truth behind the arcade machine and help reunite Ralph with his friends in the Valley.

Arcade Adventures Await

Once Ralph settles back in, you'll help him get back into the swing of Valley life.

Help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make new friends, and settle into his new home. As you level up your Friendship with Ralph, you'll take part in arcade-inspired adventures, friendly competitions, scavenger hunts, and even help repair some unexpected chaos after Ralph accidentally causes a few glitches of his own.

Of course, no update centered around Friendship would be complete without some exciting new ways to spend time with your favorite Villagers.

Best Friends Forever

Friendship is getting a major upgrade in Pixel Perfect!

As of this update, Friendship Level 10 is evolving into something brand new: Best Friends! Strengthen your bonds with your favorite Villagers to unlock special perks, enhanced bonuses, and exciting new ways to spend time together throughout the Valley.

Want to learn more? Be sure to check out our dedicated Your Guide to Best Friends blog for a complete breakdown of the feature. 

Pop City Star Path

It's time to take center stage with the Pop City Star Path!

Transform your Valley with city-core items, vibrant lighting, stylish performance outfits, and rewards inspired by the excitement of live music.

Unlock standout rewards including luminous stage pieces, show-stopping fashions inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney's The Aristocats, and a lovable calico cat companion. 

Whether you're creating the perfect performance space or dressing for your next DreamSnaps entry, this Star Path is ready to steal the spotlight.

A Pixel Perfect Premium Shop

The Premium Shop is getting a stylish refresh with plenty of new ways to personalize your Valley.

Bring a splash of summer to your favorite Biomes with the new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle, featuring vibrant new looks for all iconic Valley locations. You'll also be able to light up your skies with the all-new Meteor Shower Sky Environmental Effect, perfect for creating magical DreamSnaps moments.

Additional highlights include the Scholarly Owl and Fantasia Broomstick companions, a new Village Schoolhouse House Style and matching Village Schoolhouse Kit, plus select Premium Shop bundles that now include premade Decoration Presets to help bring your dream designs to life even faster!

New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

Pixel Perfect introduces several highly requested decorating improvements designed to give you more creative freedom than ever before.

Expand your decorating possibilities with new Biome-inspired crafting recipes, beginning with a collection of whimsical furniture pieces themed around the Peaceful Meadow. You'll also be able to Quick Save your decorating progress while still in Edit Mode, helping ensure your latest creations are never lost.

Owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale will also be able to unlock three brand-new Floating Islands inspired by the Bind, Mythopia, and Everafter, using Story Magic, with even more room to build and decorate.

Olaf's Grand Exhibition Expands

Olaf's Grand Exhibition continues to grow with two brand-new rooms opening their doors as of this update.

Journey through the Sunlit Plateau- and Frosted Heights-themed Exhibition rooms, each featuring new collections to complete and rewards to unlock.

Continue celebrating your adventures throughout the Valley while showcasing even more of your favorite memories and accomplishments!

Valley Events

There are plenty of exciting events arriving throughout the Pixel Perfect update:

Summer Sizzle Event (August 5 – August 18)

Collect marshmallows, share delicious treats with friends, and complete daily quests to unlock brand-new rewards, including picnic baskets that can be gifted for Friendship XP or sold for Star Coins, as well as a kit that lets you build a boating dock for the first time ever! 

Parks Floating Festival (August 19 – September 8)

Explore a magical Floating Island inspired by Disney Parks, solve weekly puzzles, and earn enchanting rewards.

Memory Mania (September 16 – September 29)

Join Joy from Disney and Pixar's Inside Out for the return of Memory Mania. Complete new quests, spot differences in Memories, and unlock a brand-new companion.

We can't wait for you to welcome Ralph to your Valley and experience everything Pixel Perfect has to offer. Don't forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures by tagging us in your content.

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re thrilled to have shared a first look at the Pixel Perfect free update in our latest Developer Update video! Now, let’s jump into the details of what you can expect in this update.

In Pixel Perfect, you’ll once again team up with The Forgotten, this time to fix an old arcade machine and bring Ralph, from Disney’s Wreck-It Ralph to your Valley! You’ll also be able to become Best Friends with your Villagers, upgrade your decorating skills with all new features and highly requested improvements, and much more!

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Pixel Perfect free update arrives on July 29, 2026. Check out all the details below!

NEW CONTENT OVERVIEW

To kick off the events of Pixel Perfect, you’ll need to unlock The Forgotten and Peter Pan and complete the quest “The Music on the Wall”.

  • Join the Forgotten as you investigate a glitchy arcade machine near the Dream Castle. This glitchy relic will make a few more apparitions before ending up in Vanellope’s home.

    [/*]

  • Search your Valley for pies, root beer, and bricks that you’ll need to repair the arcade and set up a beacon to free Ralph!

    [/*]

  • Once setup in your Valley, help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make some new friends, wreck a little mayhem, then fix it, to unlock awesome rewards!

    [/*]

  • Get ready to power up with the Pop City Star Path! Transform your Valley and put together a show for the stars with new luminous stage pieces and concert attires! Meet a new loveable feline companion, the paw-fect partner for this new Star Path, as well as two new outfits inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney’s Aristocats!

    [/*]

  • This update we’re also bringing back the Summer Sizzle event, from August 5th to August 18th, where you’ll collect marshmallows, share smores with your friends and complete daily quests around the Valley to unlock brand-new rewards – the first ever dock building.

    [/*]

  • Pixel Perfect will also feature a brand-new Parks Floating Festival! Arriving to the Valley from August 19th to September 8th, enter and explore the thematic floating island inspired by the best of Disney Parks to complete weekly puzzles and earn magical rewards.

    [/*]

  • Then from September 16th to September 29th, the Memory Mania event will return with new quests for you to complete alongside Joy from Disney’s Inside Out. Help spot the differences in memories, and you’ll be able to unlock a brand-new companion!

    [/*]

  • A new update means cool new swag! Coming to the Premium Shop is a brand-new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle that’ll give your Valley a splash of color with vibrant new looks for the Plaza, Dream Castle, Daisy’s Boutique, Chez Remy’s, Scrooge’s Store, and Valley Visit Station.

    [/*]

  • Alongside this new bundle arrives an all-new Environmental Effects item to the Premium Shop! The first of this kind is the Meteor Shower Sky - Fill your skies with cosmic showers, perfect for late night star watching or adding an extra radiant touch to your photos!

    [/*]

  • Get into the back-to-school spirit with a new Village Schoolhouse Skin, along with the matching Village Schoolyard Kit. Also coming this update is the charming Scholarly Owl companion and the new ionic Fantasia Broomstick companion.

    [/*]

  • In addition, we're bringing premade Presets to the Premium Shop. Select bundles, including some existing ones, will now arrive with premade Presets, allowing you to decorate your Valley with greater ease!

    [/*]

  • You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as Pink Leopard Tank Top, Dreamlight Varsity Jacket, Artist's Overalls, Enchanted Castle Tuxedo, Crimson Wayfinder Patterned Skirt, and more.

    [/*]

  • Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.

    [/*]

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or access to the Premium Shop.

UPDATE: We're happy to confirm that the Nintendo version of tomorrow's Pixel Perfect update will not contain the incompatible Clear Biome feature. Our team is still working on mitigating this issue for our Apple players.

The Pixel Perfect update was originally meant to include a "Clear Biome" feature in Furniture mode. Unfortunately, we discovered a critical bug in this feature last week, and have patched it out of the Xbox, PlayStation, Steam and Epic versions of the Pixel Perfect update. However, the feature will still be present in the Nintendo and Apple versions of the update and using it could impact various quests' progress. We recommend that our Nintendo and Apple players avoid using this feature for the time being. A hotfix will be deployed to patch the incompatible Clear Biome feature out of the Pixel Perfect update on Nintendo and Apple in the coming days. The feature will return in a later update.

FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS

OLAF’S GRAND EXHIBITION

New Exhibition Rooms

  • Finally, Olaf’s Grand Exhibition will be opening two brand new rooms for you to complete, centered on the Sunlit Plateau and the Frosted Heights. Both arriving with their own unique rewards for completion.

    [/*]

FRIENDSHIPS

General Improvements

We’ve revamped and improved how you engage with your Valley pals.

  • You’ll now be able to use Training Manuals to change any villager’s role, at any level.

    • We’re also revisiting crafting recipes to facilitate making Manuals!

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • You’ll also be able to select multiple individual items from your inventory to gift at once.

    [/*]

  • Speaking of gifts, you’ll now be able to re-roll each favorite gift, once per day.

    [/*]

New Friendship Perks

We’ve also updated the perks that come with leveling up your Friendships.

  • Level 7 friends will now also be able to assist you in gathering items! You will now be able to pick 1 item related to your friend’s base roles from any unlocked biome, and request that they collect more for you. The following day, you’ll be able to claim your item bundles from your friend.

    • There are no limits to how many friends you can request help from.

      [/*]

    • Friends will remain available in the Valley while they’re out searching for items.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • You’ll now also be able to use your Map to Fast Travel to any of your level 10 friends.

    [/*]

Best Friends!

As of Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to be Best Friends with your Valley’s villagers!

  • Once a villager reaches Level 10 Friendship, their Star Icon will be replaced with a Gold Heart progress bar. This progress bar, for all villagers, will reset daily and can only be filled once per day.

    [/*]

  • Once the new Gold Heart progress bar is filled, you’ll be able to hangout with your Best Friend and get limited time perks!

    • You and your Best Friend will have a Best Friend Glow that will last a limited time and will unlock max level roles bonus for ALL roles.

      [/*]

    • Sprinting will now affect your Best Friend Glow duration but not your Stamina.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Best Friends hangouts can only be had once per day, per villager.

    [/*]

DECORATING

New Crafting Recipes

Introducing new Biome-specific crafting recipes!

  • Complete crafter recipes utilizing ingredients from your base game Biomes to create unique furniture sets!

    [/*]

  • In Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to complete a stunning array of new fae-inspired whimsical furniture pieces for your Peaceful Meadow.

    [/*]

Edit Mode Quick Save

  • To help reduce chances of lost decoration progress, you’ll now be able to “Quick Save” your ongoing decoration changes while still in Edit Mode, without having to “Save & Exit”.

    [/*]

Storybook Vale Floating Islands

  • This update will also introduce three brand-new floating islands for owners of the Disney Dreamlight Valley - The Storybook Vale expansion.

    [/*]

  • Each island will be themed after Biomes found within the expansion, such as The Bind, Mythopia, and Everafter.

    [/*]

DREAMSNAPS

General Improvements

  • We’ve updated the UI in the 1v1 voting screens to standardize the way DreamSnaps are presented. This means both images will occupy the same amount of space.

    [/*]

  • You'll still have the option to view any image in “full screen” before voting.

    [/*]

MISC

Environmental Effects

Brand new type of decor for your Valley!

  • The Menu UI has been updated to include a “Special” section for Environmental Effects, like the Aurora Borealis and upcoming Meteor Shower Sky.

    [/*]

  • These Environmental Effects can be applied per area (Biome, Sub-Biome, or Floating Island).

    [/*]

TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES

  • We’re addressing an issue where some players didn’t receive a Vault Furniture Reward during Week 5 of the Godly Glamor Star Path. You will need to be eligible to receive a Vault Reward chest - please see our Trello tracker for details: LINK

    [/*]

  • We are aware of an issue where some players who were eligible for the Honeyglow Woods Early Adopter Bonus did not receive it. Please see our Trello tracker for details and next steps: LINK

    [/*]

  • Previously fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest “Chapter 2: About Thought, Fog, and Light“ where the shopping list disappeared and the stall can't be unlocked

    [/*]

  • Previously fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest “Chapter 4: A Tail Tale” where Sometimes Eeyore would be missing for Step 27.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack where you could interact with a flagpole early on, creating confusion.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where a green chest reward could be dropped behind a bush in the Everoak tree in Gloommeadow, making it inaccessible.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where using the Ancient Vacuum to clear the Honey Swirls in Braveheart Grove before reaching the appropriate step in "Chapter 7: A Voice Behind the Door" quest would prevent players from progressing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where flowers were not respawning quickly enough in Honeyglow Woods.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest "Interlude 3: The Shadowy Surprise" where it was too hard to interaction with the crack in the wall.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest "Interlude 3: The Shadowy Surprise" where you could get stuck with 0/4 Honeypots collected.

  • Fixed an issue in the “Interlude 2: The Gloomy Hollow” quest where the Secondary Colors Potion may not be received.
